I went here for a second opinion after an upsetting experience with my previous clinic and i’m glad i did. They were so patient and understanding with my cat who is wiggly and vocal whereas my previous vet wanted to medicate her for all future appointments (at an additional cost of course).

They were also kind enough to grab the dental surgeon so I could get a more thorough estimate and it was also less expensive than my previous clinic. Overall i was so happy with this experience

We had our first visit to Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic with our new puppy, and the experience was excellent from start to finish.

The frontline staff were quick, courteous and professional, and made us feel welcome right away. Our veterinarian was amazing. She was extremely thorough and drew on her 30 years of experience to answer all of my many questions clearly and in simple, easy-to-understand language.

What impressed me most was how calm and comfortable our puppy was with her. She took her time with him and clearly knew how to make a young dog feel safe and at ease.

We left feeling very confident that our puppy is in excellent hands. A very positive first experience, and I would highly recommend Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic.

My pup used to bolt when we went to the vet office, now he drags me inside. While it might be that he caught wise that he gets treats at the vet's office, I also think it is because of how lovely the staff are at bloorcourt.

Dr. Patel and the team were so gentle and caring with both our kitty’s. They clearly explained step by step what was being done and why. It was very calming.

Dr. Novelli was incredibly caring, attentive, and knowledgeable when treating my dog, Gucci, for his collapsed trachea. She took the time to listen to my concerns, carefully assess his condition, and explain everything clearly so I understood what was happening and what our options were. I really appreciated her compassionate approach and how genuinely attentive she was to Gucci’s comfort and wellbeing. I felt that he was in very capable hands. I’m very grateful for the care she provided and would highly recommend Dr. Novelli.

The team at Bloorcourt Vet Clinic have always been there for me and my dogs. I have been going there since 2015 with my first dog, Dakota, and now with my 2nd dog, Teduardo.

and the prices are fairer than most other places.

I highly recommend if you're looking for care for your pet.
We have taken our standard poodles to this vet for over 10 years. The service is always excellent and the staff are incredibly friendly! I am happy that they are  in the neighbourhood!
Everyone at Bloorcourt is just wonderful. Been bringing my dogs for nearly 10 years and the staff and care are invariably excellent.
Super amazing staff, no delays, really great with my anxious pup. Highly recommend!

Bloorcourt Vet Clinic is incredible! We recently visited them for our senior dog with acute and severe neck pain - they were thorough and very kind. Their communication was clear throughout, including with our options and the treatment plan. We highly recommend them.

I booked an appointment for my senior cat and they were super lovely. I usually have a pretty skittish cat but she was super comfortable! They took some blood test and got the results back with in days super haply with their services!
Super friendly, super professional. Everyone there is very helpful and easy to work with

This was our first visit to the Bloorcourt Vet Clinic. It was accessible, clean, and all of the staff were personable, professional and helpful. My cat Sylvester was very comfortable with the Vet and the vet tech. It was a very pleasant experience, thank you.

The staff handled her with care and compassion, even though she did not display her best behaviour. They managed to get everything done with minimal stress for both of us.

I visited for the first time yesterday and I was extremely impressed with the staffs and the services, definitely would recommend this place.

The clinic seems more concerned with billables than actually providing a diagnosis or answer. The vet I had during my last visit was inappropriate joking about diseases and cancers. Also broke one of my cats teeth while he was sedated. No closer to an answer as to what is wrong with him than when I first arrived. Could have just as easily used google. Might as well of lit $800 on fire. I want my pets records (which I have requested two times now) and will be going elsewhere.
Very friendly professional staff at all levels. Very patient with my semiferal cats

Always a wonderful experience, Tweak and I always feel cared for and kept in the loop with all our needs :)
Great 👍🏻 I’ve had no issues. The staff is friendly and helpful. The vet is cool. They keep my cat healthy. …

One of the best vet experiences I’ve had in Toronto. I would highly recommend bringing your pet in if you’re looking for a local vet!
Service was amazing. Staff was so friendly! Cyrus (80lb Am Bulldog) was given so much love and care. Thank you, Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic for the amazing experience! 😁 …

For almost 4 years this clinic attended my dog for annual vaccines and health checks but, last visit for a critical situation with my dog was a disaster. My dog had a problem with his inmune system that caused Glaucoma and totally blindness that today it is permanent. As a client we expect the best dictum after reviews and results of tests and we follow the treatment suggested for a professional (someone who has studied and has the experience for this). In February 13th, Dr. Vaibhavi Patel who attended, she mentioned a bacteria in this mouth and a conjunctivitis caused for that. The results attached (February 17th), showed the critical condition of my dog after the visit and the antibiotic and the medicine were not the correct to address the serious problem in his system. I had to change the vet clinic where after a fast review of the history and a new blood test results they noticed the inmune system problem. The antiobitic was changed and they addressed an inmediate attention to the problem with this eyes (high-pressure) but, sadly was too late.

I don't recommend this clinic if your pet is seriously sick. After this I had to spend more than $6000 CAD to keep it stable and recover his inmune system that it could be address at the beggining.
The staff at Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic are so friendly and knowledgable. My dog is very anxious and they were so accomodating and patient with him. Great team.

The staff at Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic are very polite and friendly. It’s been our poodles place to go when she is in need of medical attention and for her yearly checkup’s. Dr Patel & Dr Novelli  are very attentive and show such compassion towards our senior poodle. Thank you staff for always making our visit pleasant and caring for our pets. I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone who has pets.

My most recent visit was for my (very bouncy German Shepherd) dog and they were great with her as they always are and she is always excited to go there - she loves the staff and she dragged me there, walked straight over to the scale and sat on it, knowing she’d get a treat. Very happy!

After 3 years, I finally decided to change my dog's vet. My dog is incredibly quiet, gentle, never barks, and doesn't shake at the vet, but our recent experiences were unacceptable.
​First, my dog had an urgent eye emergency few weeks ago, on a Friday morning. I arrived right as they opened, only to be told the earliest they could see her was Monday. I went to another clinic nearby, and they took her in within half an hour.
​Before this, almost 6 months ago, I brought her in for a standard annual checkup and a nail trim. They took her to the back for the nail trim, and it took 45 minutes with absolutely no updates. When they finally brought her out, they casually told me, "If you see blood on her nail, don't worry."
​I have switched to a new vet and am much happier. Despite this, the clinic  called and emailed me for follow-ups, which I no longer want or need.

We recently brought our beautiful Corgi, Hyacinth, to Bloor Court Veterinary Clinic for her spay procedure, as well as her post-operative aftercare and stitch removal appointment approximately two weeks later. From beginning to end, our experience with this clinic was absolutely exceptional.

The veterinary team and front desk staff were professional, compassionate, and incredibly understanding throughout the entire process. Everyone we interacted with treated both us and our dog with genuine care and empathy, which made what can often be a stressful experience feel much more reassuring.

The veterinarian was wonderful, highly knowledgeable, patient, and attentive, and the clinic itself was immaculately clean, well-organized, and very accessible. It is clear that the staff are well-trained and genuinely dedicated to providing quality care for animals.

One aspect that stood out to us was how professionally the clinic handled an unexpected issue regarding the cost of the procedure. We had originally been quoted approximately $525 for the spay. However, after arriving, we were informed that because Hyacinth was in her first heat cycle, the procedure would be significantly more complex and the cost would increase substantially. Naturally, this came as quite a surprise to us, as we had not been aware of this beforehand.

After discussing the situation with the veterinary staff, they were extremely understanding and compassionate. The vet tech took the time to speak with the veterinarian directly, and together they worked with us to provide a much more reasonable adjusted price. We truly appreciated both their professionalism and willingness to handle the matter fairly and respectfully.

Hyacinth recovered beautifully, and her follow-up care was just as positive as the initial visit. We left feeling confident that she had received excellent medical attention every step of the way.

I would absolutely recommend Floor Court Veterinary Clinic to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care, excellent customer service, and a clinic that genuinely values both pets and their owners. We will definitely continue bringing Hyacinth back for future checkups and care.

My 3 yr old American bully, had two appointments at Bloorcourt the 1st on March 21 and  the 2nd today April 4, 2026. And with each appointment Capone and us were greeted with so much joy and respect, some may be asking why two appointments. Capone had his appointments split in two to prevent him from being stressed and overwhelmed. First appointment we went in with our guard up. But to come to our surprise that Dr. Petal went above and beyond to make Capone feel comfortable, stress free and not scared. She went as far as sitting on the floor, offering him treats, and removing her mask. During this appointment she didn’t want Capone with a mussel, it was us that asked for it as it was his first time meeting her. Before putting in the mussel Dr. Patel tried different methods to observe Capone, she sent me out and my husband stayed with her. She then sent my husband out and brought me back in. And in the end she opted for all of us to be with him during the examination part. We did end up putting the mussel on him.
Second appointment which was today on April 4, 2026. Again greeted amazingly by the girls at the front desk as always when they see Capone. Today’s appointment was to draw blood for his blood work. And again she greeted Capone with so much joy, with hopes of him wanting to be her friend. And yet again she went above and beyond for Capone going down to the floor offering him treats talking to him. The patience’s she had for him was more than we can ask for. She did the appointment without the mussel, as Dr. Patel insisted that today’s appointment was going to be mussel free. With a little  team work from us, Dr. Patel and her vet tech she was able to do what had to be done. Capone left his appointment happy and giving kisses.
In overall both appointments Capone was taken cared of amazingly from the front desk to Dr. Patel.
Thank you to everyone for making him feel comfortable and welcome as always.

I took my dog to Bloorcourt Veterinary Clinic on March 10th for his yearly vaccines and check-up. My dog has been a patient at this clinic for 3 years and has been going there since he was a puppy, so what happened during this visit was extremely upsetting.
Apparently during a phone call the day before the appointment, their AI system made a note on my dog’s file describing him as “snippy.” I was never told this at the time and had no idea this had been written in his record. The appointment began normally, although the vet made a comment referencing how my dog had been described (in the moment I didn’t really think anything of it)
I had medicated my dog beforehand as instructed, but he was still a bit nervous. For context, my dog is a small Morkie and I was holding him the entire time. The vet then requested that my dog be muzzled, which has never happened at any of his previous appointments in the past three years. I asked
for a tech to come in and hold my dog, hoping he would be a bit more complacent. I was instructed to place the muzzle on my dog and right after I stepped out and left my 10-year-old son in the room with the vet and a technician. My son later told me my dog was in extreme distress during this process. When I walked back in, my dog was clearly very stressed while being held and muzzled.
I paid for the appointment, but once I got home and saw how shaken my dog was, I called the clinic to file a complaint and requested that my records be transferred to a new veterinary clinic because I would not be returning. The vet did apologize when she called me a few hours later, but the experience had already crossed a line for me.
This morning I called because my dog’s records had still not been sent to the new clinic. During that call, the staff member accused my dog of trying to bite the vet and technician and said he was thrashing while they tried to put the muzzle on. This was simply not accurate—I was the one who put the muzzle on my dog. She also stated that an AI system had made the “snippy” note in his file during the phone call the day before.
When I asked if she had actually been in the room during the appointment, she hung up on me.
In the three years my dog has been treated at this clinic, he has never had any issues with staff. After this appointment he spent the evening hiding and didn’t want to be touched. Being told that this was just a “normal vaccine reaction” did not match what I observed.
This experience left me extremely upset and heartbroken for my dog. Unfortunately, this clinic is not what it once was. Due to the way my dog was treated and the way my concerns were handled afterward, I will not be returning and cannot recommend this clinic.

Based on the reviews it seems maybe I had a one off very bizarre experience here.

This was back in August. We had just rescued a dog and two days later I suspected she had a tape worm. Our old vet wasn't accepting new patients so I came to Bloorcourt.

The people at the front desk were very nice but when I went back to see the vet she was kind of rude. She asked why I was there and said I think our dog has a tape worm. She immediately got annoyed and said "well how did that happen?" And I said, I have no idea we just got this dog two days ago lol she's a recuse so I'm assuming from fleas from before she was rescued. She then lectured me about putting the dog on flea prevention, which she was. I had emailed all of the dogs paperwork into the practice prior to the appointment which even confirmed. She proceeded to bring up ensuring the dog is on flea prevention several more times as if she didn't believe me lol.

Anyways they sent off a fecal sample and they sent me home with some probiotics to help our pup with her stomach issues. They emailed us the next day with the results and it turned out our pup has a tape worm and giardia. They would let me know when the prescription was ready.

I called back later that day to see if the prescription was ready and the girl I spoke to had no idea what I was talking about. She couldn't find the results and didn't believe that they were sent to me lol. I had to read her the email I was sent and she responded with "okay well no prescription has even been written yet." As if that was my fault haha. She then went on to let me know that I would get a notification when it was ready. I said okay thanks. I received no notification so I called back half an hour before they closed and this person also had no idea what I was talking about and then after catching her up, she also let me know nothing had been dispensed and hopefully it would be ready tomorrow. I called the next day, mid day and they let me know that the prescription will not be ready till the next day. Which would be 3 days after finding the results which seems crazy to me.

I ended up emailing my old vet explained the situation and they were able to get me the prescription 20 minutes later. I called Bloorcourt back to let them know to not bother with the prescription I was getting it elsewhere. They still emailed me when it was finally ready 4 days later lol, a full week after the initial appointment. I have since been able to switch back to my old vet.
